_about: Live board state for the 'Love Letters' game (Vaibhav vs Shail). Reconstructed from screenshot 2026-08-18. Update 'grid' and 'rack' after every move, then run engine.py.
_premiums_legend: d=DL (double letter), t=TL (triple letter), D=DW (double word), T=TW (triple word), .=plain. Multipliers apply only to squares a NEW tile is placed on.
_premium_notes: (4,4)=DL and (4,5)=TL are now covered by G,O; they are back-calculated from the opponent's last move: G,O placed there formed GOO+GHI+POON for exactly 30 points only with G on DL and O on TL.

(6,9),(7,9),(8,9)=TL are hidden under the app's own VIRUS hint preview tiles; TL on all three is the only premium combination that reproduces the app's quoted 18 points for VIRUS given the displayed tile values (V5 I1 R1 U2 S1). Treat as inferred.
Rows 9-10 premiums are unknown (empty dark rows in the screenshot); encoded as plain.
_letter_values_note: Values read directly off tiles in the screenshot (V5 F5 Z11 N2 G3 H3 P4 C3 U2 ...). Letters not yet seen on the board (B D J K L M Q W X Y) default to Words-With-Friends values; correct them when they appear.
_rack_note: Rack shows R,I,S plus R,U,S consumed by the app's VIRUS hint preview = I,R,R,S,S,U.
